local View = {}

local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder

	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100

	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder

	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end

	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape(
			(x1 + x2) / 2,
			(y1 + y2) / 2,
			math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy),
			width or 0.14,
			math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)),
			0.5
		)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a = index * math.pi / 6
			local b = (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(
				x + math.cos(a) * radius,
				y + math.sin(a) * radius,
				x + math.cos(b) * radius,
				y + math.sin(b) * radius,
				width or 0.12
			)
		end
	end

	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, 45, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, -45, 0.5)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(
				0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33,
				0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33,
				0.26,
				0.16,
				math.deg(angle),
				0.3
			)
		end
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end

	return holder
end

local palette = {
	bgTop = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 34),
	bgBottom = Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 20),
	bgGlow = Color3.fromRGB(20, 73, 134),

	navy = Color3.fromRGB(11, 29, 53),
	navy2 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 21, 39),
	cobalt = Color3.fromRGB(41, 93, 204),
	cyan = Color3.fromRGB(59, 199, 242),
	cyanSoft = Color3.fromRGB(125, 224, 255),
	gold = Color3.fromRGB(230, 190, 89),
	goldSoft = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 150),

	text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),
	textSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(185, 212, 232),
	success = Color3.fromRGB(89, 214, 138),
	danger = Color3.fromRGB(217, 92, 92),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20),
}

local fonts = {
	display = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
	heading = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
	button = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
	body = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
	caption = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
	numeric = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
}

local function addCorner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function addStroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function addTextConstraint(parent, minSize, maxSize)
	local c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	c.MinTextSize = minSize
	c.MaxTextSize = maxSize
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function createShadow(parent, name)
	local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadow.Name = name or "Shadow"
	shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
	shadow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadow.BackgroundColor3 = palette.shadow
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex - 1
	shadow.Parent = parent.Parent
	addCorner(shadow, 24)

	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
	})
	g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.65),
	})
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Parent = shadow

	return shadow
end

local function createBackground(parent)
	local bg = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	bg.Name = "BackgroundDecoration"
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = palette.bgTop
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = parent

	local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.bgTop),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.bgBottom),
	})
	bgGrad.Rotation = 90
	bgGrad.Parent = bg

	local vignetteTop = Instance.new("Frame")
	vignetteTop.Name = "VignetteTop"
	vignetteTop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vignetteTop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
	vignetteTop.Parent = bg

	local vg1 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	vg1.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.bgGlow),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.bgTop),
	})
	vg1.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	vg1.Rotation = 90
	vg1.Parent = vignetteTop

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local ray = Instance.new("Frame")
		ray.Name = "GlowRay" .. i
		ray.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		ray.BackgroundColor3 = palette.cyan
		ray.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
		ray.BorderSizePixel = 0
		ray.Size = i == 1 and UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.05) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.04)
		ray.Position = i == 1 and UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.22) or UDim2.fromScale(0.78, 0.78)
		ray.Rotation = i == 1 and -18 or 26
		ray.Parent = bg
		addCorner(ray, 999)
	end

	return bg
end

local function createPlate(parent, name, size)
	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = name
	plate.Size = size
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	plate.Parent = parent
	addCorner(plate, 26)
	addStroke(plate, palette.navy2, 4, 0)

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cobalt),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.cobalt),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = plate

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.06)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.34)
	gloss.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
	gloss.Parent = plate
	addCorner(gloss, 18)

	local inner = Instance.new("Frame")
	inner.Name = "InnerRim"
	inner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	inner.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	inner.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
	inner.Parent = plate
	addCorner(inner, 26)
	addStroke(inner, palette.gold, 2, 0.2)

	return plate
end

local function createTitle(parent, mobile)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "TitleHeader"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.23) or UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.22)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local plate = createPlate(holder, "TitlePlate", mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.75) or UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.78))
	plate.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	plate.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = mobile and 3.8 or 4.8
	aspect.Parent = plate

	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "TitleText"
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.8)
	text.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	text.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.52)
	text.Text = "AURORA"
	text.TextColor3 = palette.text
	text.TextScaled = false
	text.TextSize = mobile and 32 or 42
	text.FontFace = fonts.display
	text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	text.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 2
	text.Parent = plate
	addTextConstraint(text, 20, mobile and 34 or 44)

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(5, 15, 28)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.4
	stroke.Transparency = 0.55
	stroke.Parent = text

	return holder
end

local function createButton(parent, name, label, role, layoutOrder, hero, mobile)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = ""
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, hero and (mobile and 64 or 74) or (mobile and 56 or 60))
	button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	button.Parent = parent

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Parent = button
	addCorner(visual, hero and 24 or 20)
	addStroke(visual, palette.navy2, hero and 4 or 3, 0)

	local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadow.Name = "Shadow"
	shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, hero and 6 or 5)
	shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	shadow.BackgroundColor3 = palette.shadow
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.56
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.ZIndex = 0
	shadow.Parent = button
	addCorner(shadow, hero and 24 or 20)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = hero and palette.cyan or palette.cobalt
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.ZIndex = 2
	fill.Parent = visual
	addCorner(fill, hero and 24 or 20)

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, hero and palette.cobalt or Color3.fromRGB(35, 84, 180)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, hero and Color3.fromRGB(36, 104, 196) or palette.cobalt),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = fill

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.08)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, hero and 0.33 or 0.28)
	gloss.ZIndex = 3
	gloss.Parent = visual
	addCorner(gloss, 18)

	local innerStrokeHost = Instance.new("Frame")
	innerStrokeHost.Name = "InnerStrokeHost"
	innerStrokeHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	innerStrokeHost.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	innerStrokeHost.ZIndex = 4
	innerStrokeHost.Parent = visual
	addCorner(innerStrokeHost, hero and 24 or 20)
	addStroke(innerStrokeHost, palette.gold, 2, 0.25)

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	content.ZIndex = 5
	content.Parent = visual

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.Parent = content

	local icon = createNexusIcon(content, role, {
		name = name .. "Icon",
		size = mobile and 26 or 28,
		padding = 10,
		color = palette.goldSoft,
	})
	icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	icon.ZIndex = 6

	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "Label"
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Position = UDim2.new(0, mobile and 42 or 46, 0, 0)
	text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(mobile and 52 or 58), 1, 0)
	text.Text = label
	text.TextColor3 = palette.text
	text.TextSize = mobile and (hero and 22 or 20) or (hero and 24 or 22)
	text.FontFace = fonts.button
	text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	text.ZIndex = 6
	text.Parent = content
	addTextConstraint(text, 16, hero and 26 or 24)

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 17, 32)
	textStroke.Thickness = 1
	textStroke.Transparency = 0.7
	textStroke.Parent = text

	return button
end

local function createMenuSurface(parent, mobile)
	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "MainMenuRoot"
	root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.48) or UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.46)
	root.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.Parent = parent
	addCorner(root, 28)
	addStroke(root, palette.navy2, 5, 0)

	local shadow = createShadow(root, "MainMenuShadow")
	shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 1, 18)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 12)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = palette.cobalt
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.Parent = root
	addCorner(fill, 28)

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(18, 43, 84)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, palette.cobalt),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(33, 128, 205)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(14, 33, 68)),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = fill

	local glossBand = Instance.new("Frame")
	glossBand.Name = "GlossBand"
	glossBand.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	glossBand.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
	glossBand.BorderSizePixel = 0
	glossBand.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.03)
	glossBand.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.18)
	glossBand.Parent = root
	addCorner(glossBand, 18)

	local innerRim = Instance.new("Frame")
	innerRim.Name = "InnerRim"
	innerRim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	innerRim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	innerRim.Parent = root
	addCorner(innerRim, 28)
	addStroke(innerRim, palette.gold, 2, 0.3)

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	content.Parent = root

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, mobile and 18 or 20)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, mobile and 18 or 22)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	padding.Parent = content

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, mobile and 12 or 14)
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = content

	createTitle(content, mobile).LayoutOrder = 1
	createButton(content, "PlayButton", "Play", "play", 2, true, mobile)
	createButton(content, "SettingsButton", "Settings", "settings", 3, false, mobile)
	createButton(content, "CreditsButton", "Credits", "credits", 4, false, mobile)

	return root
end

local function createRowBase(parent, name, mobile)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = name
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, mobile and 74 or 66)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 35, 63)
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.Parent = parent
	addCorner(row, 18)
	addStroke(row, Color3.fromRGB(21, 50, 91), 2, 0.25)

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.06)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.96, 0.28)
	gloss.Parent = row
	addCorner(gloss, 14)

	return row
end

local function createSettingsPanel(parent, mobile)
	local modal = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	modal.Name = "SettingsPanel"
	modal.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	modal.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.4)
	modal.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.42) or UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.36)
	modal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	modal.GroupTransparency = 1
	modal.Visible = false
	modal.Parent = parent

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Surface"
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Parent = modal
	addCorner(panel, 24)
	addStroke(panel, palette.navy2, 5, 0)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = palette.cobalt
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = panel
	addCorner(fill, 24)

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(14, 35, 66)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, Color3.fromRGB(33, 99, 173)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72, Color3.fromRGB(46, 138, 215)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(13, 30, 60)),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = fill

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.025, 0.03)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.18)
	gloss.Parent = panel
	addCorner(gloss, 16)

	local rim = Instance.new("Frame")
	rim.Name = "InnerRim"
	rim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	rim.Parent = panel
	addCorner(rim, 24)
	addStroke(rim, palette.gold, 2, 0.3)

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, mobile and 16 or 18)
	pad.Parent = panel

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "SettingsTitle"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 32)
	title.Text = "Settings"
	title.TextColor3 = palette.text
	title.TextSize = mobile and 22 or 26
	title.FontFace = fonts.heading
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = panel
	addTextConstraint(title, 16, 28)

	local close = createButton(panel, "SettingsCloseButton", "Close", "close", 0, false, mobile)
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mobile and 116 or 108, mobile and 48 or 44)

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Body"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, mobile and 52 or 54)
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(mobile and 52 or 54))
	content.Parent = panel

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, mobile and 14 or 12)
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = content

	local musicRow = createRowBase(content, "MusicRow", mobile)
	musicRow.LayoutOrder = 1

	local musicLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	musicLabel.Name = "MusicLabel"
	musicLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	musicLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	musicLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0)
	musicLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -16, 0, 28)
	musicLabel.Text = "Music"
	musicLabel.TextColor3 = palette.text
	musicLabel.TextSize = mobile and 18 or 18
	musicLabel.FontFace = fonts.body

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local root = script.Parent
local Responsive = require(root._NexusSource.Runtime.Responsive)
local ButtonEffects = require(root._NexusSource.Runtime.ButtonEffects)

Responsive.bind(root)

local bindings = {}
local activeTweens = {}

local function stopTween(key)
	local tween = activeTweens[key]
	if tween then
		tween:Cancel()
		activeTweens[key] = nil
	end
end

local function tween(key, object, info, goal)
	stopTween(key)
	local t = TweenService:Create(object, info, goal)
	activeTweens[key] = t
	t:Play()
	t.Completed:Connect(function()
		if activeTweens[key] == t then
			activeTweens[key] = nil
		end
	end)
	return t
end

local function allNamed(name)
	local results = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			table.insert(results, descendant)
		end
	end
	return results
end

local function isMobileMode()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return false
	end
	local size = camera.ViewportSize
	return math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
end

local function visibleBranch()
	return isMobileMode() and root:FindFirstChild("_NexusMobile") or root:FindFirstChild("_NexusDesktop")
end

local function currentNode(name)
	local branch = visibleBranch()
	if not branch then
		return nil
	end
	return branch:FindFirstChild(name, true)
end

local menuOpen = true
local settingsOpen = false
local creditsOpen = false

local openInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local closeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function setModalVisibility(modalName, visible)
	for _, modal in ipairs(allNamed(modalName)) do
		if modal:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
			if visible then
				modal.Visible = true
				modal.GroupTransparency = GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled and 0 or 1
				modal.Position = modal.Position + (GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled and UDim2.new() or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6))
				if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
					modal.GroupTransparency = 0
				else
					tween(modal:GetDebugId() .. "_openFade", modal, fadeInfo, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
					tween(modal:GetDebugId() .. "_openPos", modal, openInfo, { Position = modal.Position - UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6) })
				end
			else
				if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
					modal.Visible = false
					modal.GroupTransparency = 1
				else
					local original = modal.Position
					local fadeTween = tween(modal:GetDebugId() .. "_closeFade", modal, closeInfo, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
					tween(modal:GetDebugId() .. "_closePos", modal, closeInfo, { Position = original + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6) })
					fadeTween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
						if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
							modal.Visible = false
							modal.Position = original
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function refreshDim()
	local anyOpen = settingsOpen or creditsOpen
	for _, dim in ipairs(allNamed("ModalDim")) do
		if dim:IsA("Frame") then
			dim.Visible = anyOpen
			dim.Active = anyOpen
		end
	end
end

local function closeAllPanels()
	settingsOpen = false
	creditsOpen = false
	setModalVisibility("SettingsPanel", false)
	setModalVisibility("CreditsPanel", false)
	refreshDim()
end

local function openSettings()
	creditsOpen = false
	settingsOpen = true
	setModalVisibility("CreditsPanel", false)
	setModalVisibility("SettingsPanel", true)
	refreshDim()
end

local function openCredits()
	settingsOpen = false
	creditsOpen = true
	setModalVisibility("SettingsPanel", false)
	setModalVisibility("CreditsPanel", true)
	refreshDim()
end

local function setMenuVisible(visible)
	menuOpen = visible
	for _, branchName in ipairs({ "_NexusDesktop", "_NexusMobile" }) do
		local branch = root:FindFirstChild(branchName)
		if branch then
			branch.Visible = visible and ((branchName == "_NexusMobile") == isMobileMode())
		end
	end
	if not visible then
		closeAllPanels()
	end
end

local playHookFolder = root:FindFirstChild("PlayIntegrationHook")
local playRequestedEvent = playHookFolder and playHookFolder:FindFirstChild("PlayRequested")

local function firePlayRequestedHook()
	if playRequestedEvent and playRequestedEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		playRequestedEvent:Fire()
	end
end

local musicEnabled = true
local volumeValue = 0.72
local sliderDrag = nil

local function updateMusicToggle(toggle)
	local onNode = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual") and toggle.Visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOn")
	local thumb = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual") and toggle.Visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleThumb")
	if onNode and thumb then
		onNode.Visible = musicEnabled
		local targetPos = musicEnabled and UDim2.new(1, -(thumb.AbsoluteSize.X + 4), 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
		if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
			thumb.Position = targetPos
		else
			tween(toggle:GetFullName() .. "_thumb", thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = targetPos,
			})
		end
	end
end

local function updateSlider(slider)
	local clip = slider:FindFirstChild("Visual") and slider.Visual:FindFirstChild("VolumeSliderFillClip")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Visual") and slider.Visual:FindFirstChild("VolumeSliderHandle")
	local row = slider.Parent
	local valueLabel = row and row:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
	if clip then
		clip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(volumeValue, 1)
	end
	if handle then
		handle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(volumeValue, 0.5)
	end
	if valueLabel and valueLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(volumeValue * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
	end
end

local function applyStateToAll()
	for _, toggle in ipairs(allNamed("MusicToggle")) do
		if toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
			updateMusicToggle(toggle)
		end
	end
	for _, slider in ipairs(allNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
		if slider:IsA("GuiButton") then
			updateSlider(slider)
		end
	end
	refreshDim()
end

local function bindActionButtons()
	for _, buttonName in ipairs({ "PlayButton", "SettingsButton", "CreditsButton", "SettingsCloseButton", "CreditsCloseButton" }) do
		for _, button in ipairs(allNamed(buttonName)) do
			if button:IsA("GuiButton") and not bindings[button] then
				local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
				local shadow = button:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
				bindings[button] = ButtonEffects.bind(button, {
					visual = visual,
					shadow = shadow,
					hoverScale = buttonName == "PlayButton" and 1.04 or 1.03,
					pressScale = 0.97,
					duration = 0.12,
					sounds = false,
				})

				if buttonName == "PlayButton" then
					button.Activated:Connect(function()
						setMenuVisible(false)
						firePlayRequestedHook()
					end)
				elseif buttonName == "SettingsButton" then
					button.Activated:Connect(openSettings)
				elseif buttonName == "CreditsButton" then
					button.Activated:Connect(openCredits)
				elseif buttonName == "SettingsCloseButton" then
					button.Activated:Connect(function()
						settingsOpen = false
						setModalVisibility("SettingsPanel", false)
						refreshDim()
					end)
				elseif buttonName == "CreditsCloseButton" then
					button.Activated:Connect(function()
						creditsOpen = false
						setModalVisibility("CreditsPanel", false)
						refreshDim()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function bindToggles()
	for _, toggle in ipairs(allNamed("MusicToggle")) do
		if toggle:IsA("GuiButton") and not bindings[toggle] then
			local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual") or toggle
			bindings[toggle] = ButtonEffects.bind(toggle, {
				visual = visual,
				hoverScale = 1.02,
				pressScale = 0.98,
				duration = 0.1,
				sounds = false,
			})
			toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
				musicEnabled = not musicEnabled
				applyStateToAll()
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function sliderValueFromPosition(slider, x)
	local absPos = slider.AbsolutePosition.X
	local absSize = slider.AbsoluteSize.X
	if absSize <= 0 then
		return volumeValue
	end
	return math.clamp((x - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)
end

local function bindSliders()
	for _, slider in ipairs(allNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
		if slider:IsA("GuiButton") and not bindings[slider] then
			local visual = slider:FindFirstChild("Visual") or slider
			bindings[slider] = ButtonEffects.bind(slider, {
				visual = visual,
				hoverScale = 1.0,
				pressScale = 1.0,
				duration = 0.08,
				sounds = false,
			})

			slider.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					sliderDrag = {
						source = input,
						slider = slider,
					}
					volumeValue = sliderValueFromPosition(slider, input.Position.X)
					applyStateToAll()
				end
			end)

			slider.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if sliderDrag and sliderDrag.source == input then
					sliderDrag = nil
				end
			end)

			slider.Activated:Connect(function()
				local mouseX = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation().X
				volumeValue = sliderValueFromPosition(slider, mouseX)
				applyStateToAll()
			end)
		end
	end
end

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDrag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		volumeValue = sliderValueFromPosition(sliderDrag.slider, input.Position.X)
		applyStateToAll()
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDrag and sliderDrag.source == input then
		sliderDrag = nil
	end
end)

root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
	if not root.Enabled then
		sliderDrag = nil
	end
end)

bindActionButtons()
bindToggles()
bindSliders()
applyStateToAll()
refreshDim()

for _, dim in ipairs(allNamed("ModalDim")) do
	if dim:IsA("GuiObject") then
		dim.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				closeAllPanels()
			end
		end)
	end
end

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
